questions.question: Against which wealthy coastal city is the oracle in Ezekiel 26?
What did God say would be left of Tyre?
options: A holy city devoted to the LORD
A bare rock, a place for spreading nets
A fortress stronger than ever before
A garden full of fruit and flowing streams
questions.answer: A bare rock, a place for spreading nets

questions.question: Ezekiel 26 says many nations would come up against Tyre like the sea casting up its waves.
I will make you a bare _____, a place for the spreading of nets.
Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon would come against _____ from the north.
